offering_description.value: Distributes maintenance, repair and operating products and provides equipment repair and integrated supply services to industrial plants. Sells through a branch network and on-site inventory programs across North America.

primary_products.value: pumps; valves; bearings and power transmission products; safety products; fasteners

primary_services.value: pump and rotating equipment repair; integrated supply management; equipment packaging; fabrication and engineering

customer_segment.value: B2B: oil and gas producers, chemical plants, food processors, pulp and paper mills, water utilities and manufacturers

end_markets.value: oil and gas; chemical; food and beverage; pulp and paper; water and wastewater; mining

revenue_model.value: product sales: maintenance, repair and operating products sold to plant maintenance and purchasing teams; service fees: equipment repair, fabrication and on-site inventory management services

value_chain_position.value: distributor: buys industrial products from manufacturers and sells them to industrial end users; service provider: repairs pumps and rotating equipment and runs on-site supply programs for plant customers

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada, through branches and service centers

specialization.value: related lines: pumps, valves, bearings, safety products, repair services and integrated supply sold to the same industrial plants

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales staff calling on plant maintenance and purchasing teams; own locations: branches, service centers and on-site integrated supply locations

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: workplace safety, environmental and transport rules for handling industrial products and chemicals, such as OSHA and DOT rules
